dct_description_sm:
The recent (2017) spatial patterns of zooplankton communities in 73 Québec lakes distributed over an 800-km SW-NE gradient, spanning a wide range of water quality and climate.
Results were published in a scientific article that can be found here: https://doi.org/10.1139/cjfas-2020-0139
dct_title_s: Zooplankton communities in Precambrian Shield lakes (Québec, Canada): responses to spatial and temporal gradients in water chemistry and climate
